articles.title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
articles.snippet: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.

articles.title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
articles.snippet: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

articles.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks
articles.snippet: ChainSecurity said it identified 13 real-world examples of smart contracts potentially affected by Glamsterdam’s gas changes and is coordinating responsible disclosure with affected projects.

articles.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
articles.snippet: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

articles.title: Major Banks Find Rogue AI Agents Inside Customer Accounts—And They’re 'Horrified'
articles.snippet: Major banks including Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Bank of America, and Citi are moving to restrict third-party AI agents that log in with customers’ credentials.
